channel.title: AIBuilder Marketplace — new honest reviews
channel.description: Hand-researched, honest software reviews: real pricing, the honest knock, who should skip it. No hype, no invented numbers.

item.title: Content Raptor Review (2026): $47 per Site, GSC-Led, No Refunds
item.description: Content Raptor: Pro is $47 a month per site. The home page's endorsements, including a founder's quote comparing it with a $1,400-a-year Surfer bill.

item.title: Deftform Review (2026): €4 per Form, €25 a Month or €189 Once
item.description: Deftform: Lifetime is €189 one-time for unlimited forms, or €16 a month for 12 months as an instalment plan. The pricing is easy to misread.

item.title: FeedbackGate Review (2026): A Rating Gate Google's Rules Forbid
item.description: FeedbackGate: Three monthly plans, each with a 14-day free trial. Used as designed, it can cost you the reviews it collected.

item.title: PulseMonitor Review (2026): 50 Free Monitors, Pro $9, No Refunds
item.description: PulseMonitor: Pro is $9 a month or $90 a year. The refund policy is strict: monthly and yearly fees are non-refundable, including the unused part of a year.

item.title: WhisperTranscribe Review (2026): $19.99 for 320 Min, No Refunds
item.description: WhisperTranscribe: The terms say a cancelled account reverts to the free tier with 60 credits.

item.title: Chatwith Review (2026): AI Agent From $9, Priced in Credits
item.description: Chatwith: Starter is $9 a month or $90 a year. The real price depends on credits, and the conversation estimates assume five replies at one credit each.

item.title: CiteRoute Review (2026): Free GEO Scans, AI-Bot Data From $79
item.description: CiteRoute: Four plans, billed monthly. The GEO score is CiteRoute's own algorithm, and its terms say outright that it cannot guarantee citations or rankings.

item.title: DigiParser Review (2026): From $49/mo, Billed per Page
item.description: DigiParser: Starter is $69 a month billed monthly, or $49 a month billed yearly ($588 a year). Billing is per page, not per document.

item.title: Sender Review (2026): Free Up to 2,500 Subscribers
item.description: Sender: The Free Forever plan costs nothing, needs no card. The cheapest paid price only covers 500 subscribers, fewer than the 2,500 on the free plan.

item.title: xTiles Review (2026): Free Plan, Plus From $12.42/mo Yearly
item.description: xTiles: Plus is $19 a month, or $12.42 a month billed yearly. The free plan keeps only two weeks of planner history and caps uploads at 5MB.

item.title: HostPapa Review (2026): $2.95 Intro, Renews From $8.99
item.description: HostPapa: Growth renews at $17.99, $15.99, $14.99 or $13.99. The $2.95 is a first-term price on a 3-year term for new customers only.

item.title: Pixlr Review (2026): Cheap Plans, Credits Reset Each Renewal
item.description: Pixlr has a free version, which its FAQ describes as usable without an account or charges.

item.title: PostOnce Review (2026): €12 a Month, No Trial, No Refunds
item.description: PostOnce: Solo is €15 a month, or €144 a year billed once. The only way to look before paying is a demo with sample data, not your own accounts.

item.title: WPLP Review (2026): Priced by Site Count, Not Pageviews
item.description: WPLP: The cookie plugin's own listing says the free version already includes the cookie banner.

item.title: Pagecloud Review (2026): Pagecloud AI, No Native Blog or Store
item.description: Pagecloud — Billed annually and shown as a monthly equivalent: Launch $22, Grow $36, Optimize $69. Pagecloud AI has no native blog or online store.

item.title: Shopmonkey Review (2026): $215-$449/mo, Payment Fees Unlisted
item.description: Shopmonkey — Billed annually, which the page says saves up to 10%: Basic $215 a month, Clever $359, Genius $449. Card processing is part of the product.

item.title: Upsell & Cross Sell - AW Review (2026): Priced by Clicks
item.description: Upsell & Cross Sell - AW: StartUp Upsell is $29.99 a month or $299 a year (the listing says save 17%). The meter is recommendation clicks.

item.title: Vanity Number Review (2026): One-Time Fee From $99.99, No Refunds
item.description: Vanity Number: The catalogue is browsable by price band, from under $250 through $251 to $500, $501 to $1,000. You are buying the number only.

item.title: Vify Order Printer Review (2026): Free Stops at 50 Orders
item.description: Vify Order Printer: Premium is $29.99 a month or $299 a year and adds more templates, custom invoices and quotes, a custom sender email, commercial…

item.title: Samsara Review (2026): Seven Plans, Not One Price
item.description: Samsara: The Pricing and Plans page names seven packages. The pricing page asks how many vehicles you run and leads to a sales form.

item.title: Help Scout Review (2026): Free for 5 Users, Standard $25 a Seat
item.description: Help Scout: Standard is $25 per user a month billed annually or $30 monthly, for up to 25 users.

item.title: LifterLMS Review (2026): Free Core, Bundles Renew at $398 and Up
item.description: LifterLMS: Earth is $199 for the first year, normally $398. Taking payments needs a paid bundle, and every bundle renews at twice the first-year price.

item.title: Lusha Review (2026): 40 Free Credits, and a Phone Costs 5 of Them
item.description: Lusha: Free is $0 with 40 credits a month, 1 seat and no credit card. Annual credits are granted upfront and reset at the end of the year.

item.title: Optery Review (2026): Free Scan, Paid Removals From $3.25 a Month
item.description: Optery: Free Basic costs nothing and needs no card. Core automates removals for one name and one city and state only, with no human handling exceptions.

item.title: Brizy Review (2026): Site Builder From $19, White Label $159
item.description: Brizy: Personal is $19 a month or $190 a year for 1 website, with each additional site at $17 a month, 1 workspace and unlimited team members.

item.title: CO2 Impact Review (2026): UK Carbon Reporting From £468 a Year
item.description: CO2 Impact: No free trial or free plan is mentioned. The public table does not show in text which plan includes advanced or SECR reports.

item.title: iubenda Review (2026): Cookie Consent From €4.99 a Site
item.description: iubenda: Essentials is €4.99 billed yearly or €5.99 monthly ($5.99 / $6.99) for up to 25K pageviews. The free plan's limits are not on the pricing page.

item.title: Omneky Review (2026): AI Ads From $29 a Month, Credits Decide
item.description: Omneky: Standard is $99 a month with 1,000 credits, 3 brands and 3 seats. Lite allows one brand, one seat and one connected ad channel.

item.title: Wondershare PDFelement Review (2026): $79.99/yr or $129.99 Once
item.description: Wondershare PDFelement: The 2-Year Plan is US$109.99 (list US$149) and renews manually. A perpetual licence covers PDFelement 13, not later major versions.

item.title: 24-7PressRelease Review (2026): $29 to $479 per Release
item.description: 24-7PressRelease: Six plans, each paid per press release rather than by subscription. Every release is paid separately, from $29 to $479.
